title: cdk-construct-cloudtrail-cloudwatch-alarms examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-cloudtrail-cloudwatch-alarms/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — logGroupName + snsTopicArn from bridge fixture alarms.sns_topic_arn
- comprehensive/ — custom namespace, period, evaluation periods, threshold, subset of enabled alarms
- all-alarms/ — all available alarm types enabled

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/cloudtrail-cloudwatch-alarms-examples.test.ts.
